name: Meter
description: How much of an allowance is left, such as a usage limit that resets. Pass what is left as `value`: the bar starts full and drains. Neutral until the value reaches `low`, then the warning color; never danger.

props.name: low
props.description: At or below this value the meter is low and takes the warning color. In the same units as `value`.

props.name: aria-valuetext
props.description: A string value that provides a user-friendly name for `aria-valuenow`, the current value of the meter.

props.name: getAriaValueText
props.description: A function that returns a string value that provides a human-readable text alternative for `aria-valuenow`, the current value of the meter.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale used by `Intl.NumberFormat` when formatting the value. Defaults to the user's runtime locale.
